top_choice_rationale: P001 most strongly combines a mature foundational account of GLP-1 physiology with an exceptionally broad, durable transformation in treatment for diabetes and obesity. Its selective three-person attribution is defensible only with the citation confined to the enabling physiological discoveries, rather than the full later history of drug development.
